ValidationRule.description: QCC: Stopping users from updating the owner field when an event is closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_QCC_UnableToUpdateOwnerWhenClosed__c=TRUE, TEXT(Status__c) == 'Closed' , ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Closed'), NOT(ISCHANGED(RecoveryIsCreated__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(TotalCostSpentOnFlight_Event__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Primary_Root_Cause__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(OwnerId) && BEGINS(OwnerId, '00G')), NOT(ISCHANGED( IsEventReopened__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED(DelayCostsCompleted__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(GlobalEvent__c)), (RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Active_Event' || RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Closed_Event' || RecordType.DeveloperName == 'FlightEventOffload' || RecordType.DeveloperName == 'GlobalEvent') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Event cannot be edited while closed, please reopen to edit the event
